title: Central-Hermite Sensing and Collision for Frame-Robust Order-Resolved Relaxation on D3Q125
summary: Raw-Hermite sensing and collision on a fixed discrete-velocity set can convert a uniform translation into artificial coupling between nominally distinct nonequilibrium orders. We develop a central-Hermite formulation for a D3Q125 kinetic model with order-resolved log-Gaussian relaxation and compare three variants: raw sensing/raw collision (A), central sensing/raw collision (B), and central sensing/central collision (C).
